summary: Phase 14 (Nested derivations of the CS5 axioms) dispatch. Landed and committed: (1) the cut rule (eq. 3.1) as a genuine NestedProof constructor, InputCtx-shaped mirroring impL's output-pruning pattern, plus NestedProof.CutFree gating it out (mirrors SeqProof.cut/CutFree in LJ/Basic.lean) -- scoped build green, no sorry, no new axiom. (2) A rigorous, Lean-verified structural finding: every InputCtx-shaped NestedProof constructor (botL, cut, contract, andL, boxL, diaL, tL, fourL, bStruct, and w per eq 3.1's own stated shape if later added) produces a conclusion whose RHS is unconditionally box-shaped, never atom-shaped, at any context length -- landed as three sorry-free, axiom-free theorems (buildRhsChain_box_shape, InputCtx_fillLhs_snd_box, InputCtx_fillEmpty_snd_box). This blocks Proposition 3.1's general id at A = bottom (since botL is the sole bottom-introduction rule and cannot supply the bare .atom-shaped RHS impR's premise needs), hence blocks efq directly, and transitively blocks every other CS5ModalAxiom schema whose derivation needs general id for an arbitrary (universally-quantified, possibly-bottom) formula -- i.e. all 17 target constructors. No Completeness.lean file was created since a file of 17 non-strategic sorries (all sharing one unresolved root cause, not 17 independent deliberate skeleton points) would violate the anti-analysis strategic-sorry policy. Full writeup, evidence, and what-not-to-try guidance in the phase-14 handoff. A planning decision is needed before further dispatch: either land Phase 19's weakening/exchange admissibility (or equivalent) ahead of this phase, or get a second look at whether Proposition 3.1 has a formalization this dispatch missed (the source calls it straightforward, which is in tension with the wall found).
decisions_made: Added cut as a genuine primitive NestedProof constructor (not proved admissible), mirroring SeqProof.cut, exactly per the plan's own task wording.

Did not add w (weakening) as an extra primitive: verified it shares InputCtx.fillLhs/fillEmpty's own unconditional .box shape, so it would not resolve the efq/general-id wall (a different obstruction than what w addresses).

Did not create Completeness.lean with placeholder sorries: all 17 axioms share one unresolved root cause, which fails the strategic-sorry policy's per-theorem, independently-justified scoping requirement.
Marked Phase 14 [BLOCKED] in the plan file rather than silently narrowing scope or fabricating a proof.
dead_ends: genId as a uniform induction on A targeting OutputCtx.fillFull (A, A): the A = bottom case is a proven dead end (botL is InputCtx-shaped, unconditionally .box-shaped RHS), not a matter of trying harder tactics.
Using boxR to shed botL's box wrapping: boxR's premise needs an .empty LHS component; botL's output always has bottom (or Lambda.fillLhs bottom) there, never .empty.
Using the newly-landed cut to bridge a botL-derived boxed fact down to a bare fact: cut's own conclusion (ctx.fillEmpty) is InputCtx-shaped and subject to the exact same box-shape proof.

A nonempty-length OutputCtx for id (which can itself produce a .box-shaped result) superficially looks promising for matching an InputCtx-shaped premise elsewhere, but id's own comma order (filled-formula first) does not match InputCtx.fillLhs's recursion order (context-head first) at the position needed -- a second, independent obstruction (NestedLhs.comma is a raw, non-quotiented constructor per Syntax.lean's own documented design note).
